prose: The Financial Times reports that SemiAnalysis estimates about 90% of Anthropic's business comes from agentic AI, and that sources say nearly 25% of Anthropic's 2025 revenue came from just two clients. Powerful AI tools burn through budgets, which is prompting a rethink of how the technology is priced before frontier-lab IPOs. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the FT article was not retrieved.
highlights: ~90% of Anthropic's business is agentic AI (SemiAnalysis estimate)
Nearly 25% of 2025 revenue from two clients
Agent costs are forcing a pricing rethink
